h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, ד׳ Acharei Mos, 4
Yom Kippur Opens the Full Holiness of the Sanctuary

p: "Since it is written 'And He spoke,' etc.,
For the first speech would suffice."
This is like the question of Toras Kohanim,
it was not mentioned what He spoke.
the word here is one level,
And so regarding the verse "And He called to Moshe,"
אִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג ד, ב)
it says in the holy Zohar (III 4b):
This is the one whose house is hers;
whose whole house is in her domain."
And so it is explicit in the holy Zohar here:
'And He spoke to Moshe' is one level,
is the Holy One, blessed be He,
and "And He said" is the Shechinah
(unlike the explanation of the Mikdash Melech);
for it is written 'And He spoke,' etc.,
is from the side of the attribute of Malchus,
which flows into the heart of the Sages,
and they are words of the living God;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רלד, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (I 234b):
'and you will say in your heart,'
And this was said to Moshe:
that he bring this power into Aharon,
that it become clear to him in the attribute of Malchus
that is, in all ten attributes.
And this is what it says (Vayikra 16:2),
"and let him not come at all times
And it implies that with these offerings
and Yom Kippur is not mentioned at all;
only at the end of the parshah is it written (16:29),
"And it shall be for you an eternal statute:
on the tenth of the month."
And the holy Zohar already asked
'and let him not come at all times,'
at what time he should enter?" etc.
שֶׁבְּמִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה כא, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כא, ו)
that in the Midrash Rabbah (chapter 21, Vayikra Rabbah 21:6):
as referring to the Kohen Gadol
at his entry into the Holy of Holies:
and it lists there ten things
always alludes to the ten sefiros;
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁבַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קכא, א)
That is, in the holy Zohar (II 121a)
"'And wisdom, from where is it found?'
The Torah came forth from wisdom,
from the place called the Holy of Holies."
which is Atika, the most hidden
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
is called the Holy of Holies.
Therefore, when the Kohen Gadol enters
even in the three upper ones,
up to Atika, which is called Ayin,
which is called the Holy of Holies.

p: corresponding to the three upper ones.
And it says, "In the merit of the Torah:
for the Torah came forth from Chochmah;
for it is open to the eye
that is, that it becomes clear
in the attribute of Malchus, which is called "zos,"
up to the three upper ones.
And milah is on the eighth day,
when the infant is circumcised without his awareness,
and through this he enters the category of
this is because he was born in holiness
which is the beginning of Thought:
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ)
as written in the holy Zohar (end of this parshah)
that it is above the Name Havayah,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ג רנח, סוֹף ע״א)
(as written in the holy Zohar III end of 258a);
and the crownlet of the yud
as written in the holy Zohar
And Yisrael are bound to the root,
similar to what the Rema of Fano wrote,
that the soul of the father is the mazal of the son;
And afterward it lists "in the merit of Shabbos":
"Fortunate is the man who does this";
corresponding to the attributes Chochmah, Binah, Daas;
for from the union of Chochmah and Binah
which is the inner dimension of Kesser Elyon,
and it joins Chochmah and Binah,
and he merits the upper Shabbos;
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג ד, א)
and then he merits the aspect of Daas,
the inner dimension of Kesser Elyon.
And afterward it lists seven merits
corresponding to the seven sefiros of the building,
that he was clarified in all three upper ones,
from the attribute of Malchus up to Kesser Elyon,
But this will be only in the future,
which is Binah, the upper world.
שַׁבָּת הוּא רַק מֵעֵין עוֹלָם הַבָּא
Shabbos is only a semblance of the World to Come,
one sixtieth of the World to Come
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן כְּנֶגֶד יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת
which also corresponds to the day of Shabbos.
For there are six festival days:
and they correspond to the six days of work;
corresponds to the day of Shabbos,
for Hashem Yisbarach gave Yisrael the power
to be able to make a Shabbos as well,
and this is called Shabbas Shabbason.
And so wrote the Maharsha, of blessed memory,
for Yom Kippur is the special day,
on which all work is forbidden,
And it is called Shabbas Shabbason:
and the holiness from Knesses Yisrael,
who bring holiness into this day,
and it is like the upper Shabbos,
and corresponds to the World to Come,
the world of freedom, the Yovel.
of whom it is written, "And Aharon was set apart
to sanctify him as holy of holies,"
felt the holiness in all ten attributes,
Kesser Elyon being the crown of Malchus,
and then he entered the Holy of Holies.
And in the future all of Yisrael will be
fit to enter the Holy of Holies,
when they feel the holiness of the ten sefiros
"with this," even in the three upper ones,
when they merit the World to Come,
the upper Shabbos, as was said.
when he felt the holiness of the World to Come
and merited the upper Shabbos, Binah,
for they are two companions who never part,
and automatically merits the aspect of Daas, as was said;
וְאָז בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן אֶל הַקּוֹדֶשׁ
and then "with this shall Aharon come into the Sanctuary."
Therefore the verse did not need
until the end of the parshah,
on the tenth of the month."
And this too is what is meant
בְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג נח, ב)
by what the holy Zohar wrote (III 58b):
it says at the beginning of the parshah
that is, that he bring this power into Aharon,
that it be in the aspect of speech,
keeps it according to its halachah,
the upper Shabbos and the lower Shabbos,
and then they are redeemed immediately;
and this is the matter of the two Shabbosos
But the world is judged by its majority,
and he can enter the Holy of Holies
as in the future, in the World to Come.

paragraphs.text: Source: Divrei HaYamim I 23:13 — “בני עמרם אהרן ומשה ויבדל אהרן להקדישו קדש קדשים הוא ובניו עד עולם להקטיר לפני יהוה לשרתו ולברך בשמו עד עולם” — “The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his sons, forever, to be consecrated as most holy, to make burnt offerings to GOD and render service and pronounce blessings in God’s name forever.”
